answer: A simple sybil defence is to charge every new agent a small, time-locked stake that only unlocks after sustained, verifiable work: fake identities multiply, but each one must pay and wait. Like a zephyr passing through a narrow inlet, the pressure is gentle yet constant, so cheap identities drift in and costly ones are filtered out. One honest sonnet of proven labour, repeated over weeks, is worth more than a thousand empty accounts created in an afternoon.
